hospitalDetails.name: Orlando Health Bayfront Hospital — Center for Women and Babies
hospitalDetails.paragraph: Located on the third floor of Johns Hopkins All Children's Hospital, Orlando Health Bayfront Hospital Center for Women and Babies offers modern labor and delivery suites, comprehensive maternity care, and immediate access to a Level IV NICU — making it a strong choice for families in Saint Petersburg seeking high-level obstetric support close to home.

hospitalDetails.name: HCA Florida St. Petersburg Hospital — Women's Center
hospitalDetails.paragraph: HCA Florida St. Petersburg Hospital's Women's Center provides a secure labor and delivery unit with private rooms where new families can bond under the care of certified nurses and skilled physicians. The hospital supports doulas, offers midwife-attended births, and provides IBCLC lactation services for postpartum breastfeeding support.
hospitalDetails.doulaPolicy: Patients may bring their own doulas
hospitalDetails.babyFriendly: Full-service 215-bed hospital with IBCLC lactation services

birthCenterDetails.name: Breath of Life Women's Health & Birth Center
birthCenterDetails.paragraph: Breath of Life Women's Health and Birth Center, located at 1900 East Bay Drive in Largo, received its CABC accreditation status becoming Florida's only accredited birth center. CNM-led midwifery services with birth suites and water birth options.
